description:
60 years ago, a young woman was left to die in the abandoned school building behind the exclusive Seikyou Academy. No one knows why. No one knows how. But the horrifying tale and the legends of the ghostly haunting that followed live on to this day. Perhaps it's not so surprising then, that among Seikyou's many school clubs is one for students interested in "paranormal investigations." What might raise more than a few hairs, however, is that the founder of the club is the ghost herself. Unable to remember how she died and trapped in the grey land between life and death, Yuuko latches onto Teiichi Niiya, a freshman who can inexplicably see her, and together they and the other unsuspecting members of the club begin to unravel the many dark mysteries that surround Seikyou. Will unlocking the secret of Yuuko's gruesome death finally free her? Or will her sudden close association with a mortal have even stranger repercussions on both of their existences?

(Source: Sentai Filmworks)

__Age:__ 15 ~!(at the time of death) 75 years old (current age)!~
A young girl who was left to die alone in the old school building of Seikyou Private Academy long ago. She has no recollection of how she died and is currently searching for clues together with [Teiichi Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi). As a ghost, she is normally invisible to the people in the school, with the exceptions of Teiichi and [Kirie Kanoe](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie), a blood relative who can also see her.

Apparently, she has grown fond of Teiichi and has expressed her desire to be by his side forever.   Except for Teiichi, the other members are unaware that Yuuko is actually the 'absentee' president of the Paranormal Investigations Club.   Meanwhile, the surname "Kanoe" is derived from the 7th sign of the Chinese calendar, which originally meant "evening star" and also means "a person's age".

In the anime series, Yuuko is attributed to autumn leaves and the sky during sunset, which both share the same fiery hues. "

Teiichi is a pupil in the school [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko) died about 50 years ago, he once heard rumors about a spirit in the school who was left to die alone. Teiichi is able to see her and wants to help Yuuko to find out why she died.

In her first appearance, she warns [Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi) about [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko).

~!Kirie is the only other character who can see Yuuko. She is a member of Yuuko’s family and looks exactly like Yuuko except for her short hair, ear piercings, and smaller breasts (much to her resentment).  She later joins as one of the three members of the paranormal investigations club.  The other members, Niiya and [Momoe](https://anilist.co/character/42926/Okonogi-Momoe), seem to be her closest friends. Even after joining the club she remains apprehensive of Yuuko, but accepts Niiya's judgment.!~

The most enthusiastic member of the Paranormal Investigations Club, Momoe is a year older than [Niiya](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi) and begins to develop feelings for him after seeing his dedication to solving the Seven Mysteries. Like most people, she is not able to see [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko).

Momoe also becomes close friends with [Kirie](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie) by the time of the school festival. Officially, Momoe is a member of the school's Third Newspaper Club, but she is able to participate in the activities of both clubs due to the unofficial nature of the Paranormal Investigations Club.

She is also someone who easily believes in any urban legend she comes across.
Yukariko is [Kirie](https://anilist.co/character/39417/Kanoe-Kirie)'s grandmother and one of the school directors. She is [Yuuko](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko)'s younger sister.

[Yuuko Kanoe](https://anilist.co/character/30273/Kanoe-Yuuko)'s friend. Suffered from unknown illness during the plague epidemic 60 years ago. Appears in flashback in episode 10.

~!She is actually [Teichii](https://anilist.co/character/34471/Niiya-Teiichi)'s grandmother!~
A second year student who shares the same first name with the ghost in the school's stories. Because of this, she becomes the target of unwanted attention from the other students around her.
He was the village chief 60 years ago.
